senses.gloss:
Culaka
adv. Kotah 395.

Culuka
bhakti. by Varadācārya. Oudh 1876, 30.
Same a. Tattvatrayaculuka ?

Culla
ins. poet. an. privy councillor of Arthapati Bhaṭṭāraka of the family of King Nala; drafted the Kesaribeda Plate of the king. See Epi. Ind. XXVIII. 12; Bhand. Ins. of N. I. no. 1876.

Cullakappasuya
Ukkāliya sutta ref. to in Nandī (s. 44); explanation of Kalpa.
See Kapadia, Canonical Lit. of the Jainas p.. 26. 102.

Cullagandhavaṃsa
See Gandhavam3sa, NCC. V. p. 308b.

Culladhammapāla
one of the 10 ācāryas of Jambudvīpa ref. to in Gandhavam3sa p.. 66. 77 (See JPTS. 1888, p. 33).
--Saccasaṅkhepa. Fausböll 120.
See Dhammapāla below.

Cullaniddeśa
Bud. in continuation of Mahāniddesa. from Suttapiṭaka of Khuddakanikāya. Br. Mus. Pāli II. p. 109.
On the Adyar ms. see Adyar Library Bulletin XI. iii. p.. 34-35.
Pt.. PTS. (1) 1918. (2) Nalandā Devanāgarī Pālī Series. 1959.

Cūlaniddesa
Bud. Pāli from Suttapiṭaka. Colombo p. 48. Colombo D. I. 85 (inc.). 1780. Fausböll 74.
Mentioned in a. inscription a. Pagan d. 1442 A. D., See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p. 104. [Page071-b]
Pt.. (1) in the entire text edn. of Suttapiṭaka. Bangkok, 1894. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 692. (2) Rangoon, 1917. (3) PTS. 1916-18. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 1052. 1060-61.
--C. Saddhammapajjotikā.
Ed. Text an. C. Rewata Thera an. Ñanissara Thera. Simon Hewavitarne Bequest, Vol. 14. Colombo, 1923.

Cullanirutti
or Cullaniruttigandha. one of the oldest Pāli gr. ascribed to Mahākaccāyana, a. of the Kaccāyanavyākaraṇa.
See Gandhavam3sa 59 (JPTS. 1888. p. 33); also Ind. Cult. XV. p. 198.

Cūlanirutti
Pāli. gr. written in C. 12th Cent. based a. Kaccāyanavyākaraṇa. IO. Pāli p. 102 (no. 77). Paris Pāli p. 36 mentioned in a. inscription a. Pagan d. 1442 A. D. See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p.. 37. 55n6. 105.

Cūlānirutti
Pāli. gr. Colombo p. 55. See Cūlanirutti above.

Cullanirutti(abhinava)
Bud. Pāli. gr. by Siri Saddharmābhilaṅkāra Thera. Colombo D. I. 2067.

Cullabuddha
or culla(cUla)vajira(buddhi) or cullavimalabuddhi
--Atthavyākhyāna. Bud. Pāli. gr.
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 101a. [Page067-b]

Cullavagga(cūlavagga)
from Vinayapiṭaka. Bud. Pāli.
Br. Mus. Pāli 135 (4 mss.). Colombo p. 47 (2 mss.). Colombo D. I. 6. 2363. Fausböll 8-9. IO. Pāli p.. 59. 64 (no. 8.). Kandy II. p. 1. Paris Pāli p. 32 (3 mss.). Providence Pāli 4.
Pt.. (1) in Roman Script. Vinaya Piṭaka Vol. 2. London, 1880. (2) Alutgama, 1909. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-1928. 1244. (3) Nalandā Devanāgarī Pāli Ser. 1956.
For a. ed. in fr. see ABORI. XXXIII. p.. 197-210.
Eng. transl. (1) Horner. Sacred Books of the Buddhists. Vol. 20. 1949. (2) SBE. XVII. p.. 229-439. XX. p.. 1-414.
--C. Aṭṭhakathā by Buddhaghoṣa. Br. Mus. Pāli II. p. 108 (a..). Colombo D. I. 1752.

Cullavedallasutta
Bud. from Suttapiṭaka, Majjhimanikāya.
Pt.. with Sinhalese transl. Colombo, 1897. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 707.

Cullikābhaṭṭavṛtti
Q. by Rāyamukuṭa on Amara. II. 1. 6. See Aufrecht, ZDMG. 28. p. 109.

Cullibhaṭṭi
a. of a Vṛtti on a.gr. work. q. in Tantrapradīpa etc.
See Intro. p. 1 to edn. of Dhātupradīpa (of Maitreyarakṣita), Savitārāya Smṛtirakṣaṇa Granthamālā, 2, Varendra Research Society, Rajshahi, 1919.

Cūlaº
See also Culla above.

Cūlakammavibhaṅgasutta
Bud. Pāli. from the Majjhimanikāya (III. 4. 5.). of Suttapiṭaka. Br. Mus. Pāli p. 139. Colombo D. I. 164. 165.
For French transl. see AMG. V. 492-502.

Cūlagaṇa
one of the texts mentioned in the list found in a. inscription a. Pagan d. 1442 A. D. See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p. 105.

Cūlagaṇṭhipada
Bud. Vinaya text. attributed to Moggallāna. See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p.. 75. 76.

Cūlaniddesa_Aṭṭhakathā
one of the texts mentioned in the list found in a. inscription a. Pagan d. 1442 A. D. See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p. 104. p. 411.

Cūlaniruttimañjūṣā
Bud. one of the works mentioned in a. inscription a. Pagan d. 1442 A. D. See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p. 107.

Cūlamaṇisāra
one of the works mentioned in a. inscription a. Pagan d. 1442 A. D. See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p. 108.

Cūlayuddhakāravaṃsa
Bud. Pāli. Siamese chronicle composed by Vanaratana during the reign of Rāma I.
Pt.. Pāli Text with Siamese version. Bangkok, 1920. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 1167.

Cūlarūpasiddhi
Bud. Pāli. gr. Colombo D. I. 2068.

Cūlavaṃsa
Bud. Pāli chronicle of Ceylon upto 1815 A. D.; continuation of Mahāvam3sa by Dhammakītti an. others.
See Malalasekhara, Dictionary of Pāli Proper Names Vol. I. p. 901. [Page072-a.
Pt.. PTS. in Roman script. 2 Vol.. 1923. 1927.
Transls. (1) German. transl. Wm. Geiger (2) Eng. transl. based on German by Mrs. C. M. Rickmers. PTS. Transl. Ser. 18. 20. 1929-30.

Cūlasaddanīti
Bud. Pāli. by Agga Paṇḍita. Colombo D. I. 2069. See Saddanīti.

Cūlasandhivisodhana
Bud. one of the texts mentioned in the list in a. inscription a. Pagan d. 1442 A. D.
See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p. 105.

Cūlikā
Jain. BP. p. 2. 3a.
--by Gurudāsa.
--C. Vivaraṇa by Śrīnandī. CPB. 7201. See Prāyaścittacūlikā.

Cūlikāgīta
Jain. Firenze 562.

Cūlikādyupaniṣadaḥ
BORI. 17 of 1891-95.
--C. Dīpikā. Ānandāśrama 4612. See below.

Cūlikāpaiśācika
Jain. JASB. 1908, p. 415b (no. 7504).
